question: What aspects of the divine are honored in this repeated salutation?
premises: Salutation is offered to the qualityless one.
Salutation is offered to the one of true form.
inference: Therefore, the salutation honors both the qualityless and true-form aspects of the divine.
plain_english: Obeisance to you, the qualityless one; obeisance, obeisance to you, whose form is true being.
